verdict.rationale: Docs say the Khoj server installs via Docker or pip, with a standard docker-compose.yml, and runs self-hosted on consumer hardware [khoj-docs-23, khoj-docs-44, khoj-docs-55, khoj-docs-3]. A hands-on community report concretely contradicts this: docker build failed on an unsatisfiable pyside6 requirement and pip install exited with code 1 [khoj-comm-4]. Another user found chat needed an OpenAI key rather than working locally out of the box [khoj-comm-11]. Missing for 10: a single documented copy-paste command with time-to-first-chat evidence, independent confirmation that current Docker/pip installs succeed, and proof that chat works without external API key setup.
